hypothesis: Reduce observed Q2 PP register spills by bounding K-loop fragment lifetimes, following the UD principle of bounded temporary register use.
change: Disable automatic expansion of the Q2 integer K loop on RDNA3 only. No compiler barrier, allocation, precision, quantization, weight representation, tile geometry or explicit arithmetic change.

operator_gate.reference_comparison: All recorded operator F32 bytes must match the same extended harness against the baseline. Original IQ2/Q2 checks plus Q2 tile16/32/48/64/80 with aligned64/ragged65 output rows and small/ordinary inputs.

model_gate: Every collected input/output/frontier file must match the corresponding original Q2 profile or benchmark. No KL relaxation for this scheduling-only candidate.
profile_gate: Compare marked PP kernel durations and private-segment metadata against original trace; private bytes are a spill hypothesis, not proof of dynamic traffic or a wall-speed guarantee.
performance_gate: A diagnostic gain must survive unprofiled Q2 C1 512/2048/8192 and a UD control; overall Q2 acceptance still requires no degradation versus UD.
coordination: No remote load until core explicitly releases its active campaign; reacquire all four leases per GPU/build arm.
static_screen: The token-tile barrier reduces spill metadata for some tiles but increases tile16. Disabling K-loop unrolling removes scratch instructions for all selected widths in local device-only assembly. This is not target performance or numerical evidence.
